pr_title: Fix task list checkbox toggle to work with YAML front matter
pr_body:
Fixes #25160.

`data-source-position` of checkboxes in a task list was incorrect whenever there was YAML front matter.  This would result in issue content or PR descriptions getting corrupted with random `x` or space characters when a user checked or unchecked a task.
pr_comments: Could there be a check when updating the content with `x`? Check whether there is `[` and `]` around it, then it could avoid corrupting.

> Could there be a check when updating the content with `x`? Check whether there is `[` and `]` around it, then it could avoid corrupting.

Like a runtime assertion?

> > Could there be a check when updating the content with `x`? Check whether there is `[` and `]` around it, then it could avoid corrupting.
> 
> Like a runtime assertion?

Somewhat. It's not a must for this PR, but I can see a case for it (corruption):

1. user opens page 1 
2. user opens page 2
3. user clicks edit the comment on page 1 and save
4. user click checkbox on page 2 (now, the content is still old on page 2)
5. without the check, the `x` would corrupt the content
Waiting whether we want to adress https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/pull/25184#issuecomment-1587732485 here or not.

> Somewhat. It's not a must for this PR, but I can see a case for it (corruption):
> 
>     1. user opens page 1
> 
>     2. user opens page 2
> 
>     3. user clicks edit the comment on page 1 and save
> 
>     4. user click checkbox on page 2 (now, the content is still old on page 2)
> 
>     5. without the check, the `x` would corrupt the content

I don't think this scenario is possible. The operation in number 4 will completely overwrite the changes in number 3. Checking the box publishes all of the stale content, not just the new checkmark so it will still be correct relative to the content being published.

Unless something has changed since this comment https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/issues/24253#issuecomment-1517646488, I don't think we currently handle multi-window editing or re-syncing after the page loads.

However, I did make an update to prevent markdown corruption if there's ever another bug.  If it can't see bracket characters before and after and either a space or `x` character where it's changing, it will prevent the toggling from happening.

> Waiting whether we want to adress [#25184 (comment)](https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/pull/25184#issuecomment-1587732485) here or not.

No need to wait my comment since I have approved, that's just a nit/question from my opinion.

issue_context.title: Toggling checkbox in task list corrupts markdown when there's YAML front matter
issue_context.body: ### Description Steps to reproduce: 1. Go to New Issue page 2. Fill in a title, and for content, fill in both YAML front matter and a task list, such as the below: ``` --- foo: bar --- - [ ] checkbox ``` 3. Click "Create Issue" 4. Once the issue is created, a checkbox is rendered. Click the checkbox to make it checked. 5. Reload the page I expected the checkbox to be checked and all other text including front matter to be the same as was originally entered. Instead, a seemingly random character in the middle of the front matter or other markdown text content, depending on character positions, is replaced by an `x` character. Unchecking will replace the character with a space character. The problem has also been observed in pull request descriptions. Demo: https://try.gitea.io/shravya/testing/issues/1 ### Gitea Version 1.20.0+rc0-12-g63a429581 ### Can you reproduce the bug on the Gitea demo site? Yes ### Log Gist _No response_ ### Screenshots ### Git Version _No response_ ### Operating System _No response_ ### How are you running Gitea? Using try.gitea.io. ### Database None
